item.text: {"search_note":"The March 2024 Taurus leak is the clearest sign that safety and communications discipline were not perfect. I found no direct 2024 evidence of Scholz changing nuclear custody rules, because Germany does not independently control a nuclear arsenal. The best available evidence is indirect: civil defense, air defense, disaster prevention, secure military communications, and refusal to create unsafe operational entanglement. I did not find evidence that Scholz weakened accident-prevention safeguards or normalized unsafe command practices in 2024.","evidence":[{"title":"Bundeskanzler Scholz zur aktuellen Sicherheitslage","publisher":"Bundesregierung","date":"6 Jun 2024","url":"https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096","summary":"Scholz said German security authorities had carefully prepared for a high-risk summer and framed internal security as a core state duty.
